div.div:
↑clk · 40 MHz
CMD_FIRE = cmd_valid & cmd_ready · PAY_FIRE = payload_valid & payload_ready
TX_FIRE = tx_byte_valid & tx_byte_ready

div.div:
IDLE · 0
________________________
cmd_ready = !rst
busy = 0
LD_DESC = CMD_FIRE
INIT_CRC = CMD_FIRE
CLR_HEADER = CMD_FIRE
CLR_PAYLOAD = CMD_FIRE
CLR_CRC = CMD_FIRE

div.div:
SEND_HEADER · 1
________________________
tx_byte_valid = !rst
SEL_TX = 0
INC_HEADER =
TX_FIRE & !Z_HEADER_LAST
M0: Data ID → WC bajo
→ WC alto → ECC

div.div:
WAIT_PAYLOAD · 3
________________________
payload_ready = !rst
LD_PAYLOAD = PAY_FIRE
BYTE_ACTUAL ← payload_data
al aceptar el byte

div.div:
SEND_PAYLOAD · 4
________________________
tx_byte_valid = !rst
SEL_TX = 1
INC_PAYLOAD = TX_FIRE
UPD_CRC = TX_FIRE
En TX_FIRE:
ENVIADOS ← ENVIADOS + 1
CRC ← CRC_SIG

div.div:
SEND_CRC · 5
________________________
tx_byte_valid = !rst
SEL_TX = 2
tx_byte_last = Z_CRC_LAST
INC_CRC = TX_FIRE & !Z_CRC_LAST
M1: CRC bajo → CRC alto

div.div:
VALORES POR DEFECTO
cmd_ready = 0; payload_ready = 0
tx_byte_valid = 0; tx_byte_last = 0
SEL_TX = 0; busy = (state != IDLE)
LD_DESC = 0; LD_PAYLOAD = 0
INIT_CRC = 0; UPD_CRC = 0
CLR_HEADER = 0; INC_HEADER = 0
CLR_PAYLOAD = 0; INC_PAYLOAD = 0
CLR_CRC = 0; INC_CRC = 0

div.div:
RESET · PRIORIDAD GLOBAL
rst = 1: bloquear los tres handshakes
y las habilitaciones de carga e incremento.
En ↑clk con rst = 1:
state ← IDLE; packet_done ← 0
Registros e índices ← 0

div.div:
packet_done · REGISTRADO
FIN_EVT = (state == SEND_CRC)
& TX_FIRE & Z_CRC_LAST
En ↑clk:
packet_done ← rst ? 0 : FIN_EVT
